AfterSideTurnStart.issue: Rollup of guard G1 per binding rule 4. The slot, the guards and the charge accounting are all right -- post-draw (turn_structure step 23, executed via the turn-order probe), `IsUsedUp` / `participants` / `TurnNumber > 1` all reproduced (bone_tea.py:32), and CombatsLeft-- matches -- but the upgrade call itself is unguarded.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): C# upgrades the opening hand with CardCmd.Upgrade, which SKIPS any card whose IsUpgradable is false (BoneTea.cs:53-56); the sim calls the unguarded Card.upgrade() (bone_tea.py:34-35)
guards.issue: MECHANISM: CardCmd.Upgrade(IEnumerable, style) guards each card with `if (!card.IsUpgradable)` and skips it; IsUpgradable is `CurrentUpgradeLevel < MaxUpgradeLevel` (CardModel.cs:785-789). Card.upgrade() in the sim (cards/base.py:146-147) is a bare `self.upgrade_level += 1` with no guard, and bone_tea.py:34-35 loops the whole hand through it -- unlike relic/bellows, whose otherwise identical upgrade-the-opening-hand port DOES check `card.is_upgradable`. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes.py batch2): a hand of [strike, dazed, burn] comes out at upgrade_level [1, 1, 1] where C# gives [1, 0, 0]. An executed census puts 35 of 203 ported cards at max_upgrade_level 0 (18 Curse, 14 Status, 3 Quest), and statuses reach the opening hand routinely -- relic/blessed_antler, audited in this very batch, shuffles three Dazed into the turn-1 draw pile, and Bone Tea fires post-draw. The divergence is not cosmetic: conformance/runner.py:618 compares the deck as (id, upgrade_level) pairs against the save, and conformance/combat_driver.py:34 renders the '+' suffix from the same field. Bone Tea is obtainable from the ported Tea Master event. CLUSTER: this is the second instance of PROMPT.md bug class 14 in two batches (relic/astrolabe was the first), so it was swept -- py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-upgrade finds SEVEN unguarded .upgrade() call sites across six relics: _eggs.py (x2), astrolabe, bone_tea, burning_sticks, dusty_tome, neows_talisman. The _eggs pair is dormant (the egg relics filter to Attack/Skill/Power and every level-0 card is Curse/Status/Quest); the rest are unaudited and listed in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md.

guards.what: N1: `combats_left` is never reset at a combat boundary and C# never resets it either
guards.rationale: Bone Tea is a single-charge, whole-RUN relic: `_combatsLeft = 1` is a field initialiser (BoneTea.cs:7) with no BeforeCombatStart or AfterCombatEnd override anywhere in the file, and the sim mirrors that with a constructor default (bone_tea.py:25). Verified against the pool-wide scan (py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset), which flags bone_tea as never-reset but correctly reports 'C# resets: NONE' -- the marker that separates a per-run counter from the relic/belt_buckle defect, where C# resets in three places and the sim in none.

The `player != base.Owner` / `shuffler == base.Owner` / `cardPlay.Card.Owner != base.Owner` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player. The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState), so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.
